components.css: :host{--ramp-0:#0a0910;--bg:#0f0e14;--surface:#17151f;--surface-2:#211d2c;--rule:#2a2638;--edge:#6e6789;--ink:#f5f3fa;--muted:#aaa4bf;--violet:#7030e0;--violet-press:#5f24c4;--lav:#a19df0;--good:#5ee0a0;--warn:#f5c04e;--bad:#ff7a90} .ds-pass{width:340px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--surface);color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 22px 44px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.8),0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}.ds-band{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;padding:10px 14px;background:var(--violet);color:#fff;font:800 16px "Big Shoulders Display", "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif;letter-spacing:.08em}.ds-band span{font:600 12.5px "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace;letter-spacing:0}.ds-body{padding:14px}.ds-date{margin:0;font:900 46px/.92 "Big Shoulders Display", "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif}.ds-venue{margin:6px 0 0;font:700 17px "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif}.ds-venue span{font-weight:400;color:var(--muted)}.ds-fields{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr 1fr;margin:0;border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}.ds-fields div{padding:10px 14px;border-left:1px solid var(--rule)}.ds-fields div:first-child{border-left:0}.ds-fields dt{font:800 12px "Big Shoulders Display", "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif;letter-spacing:.14em;color:var(--muted)}.ds-fields dd{margin:5px 0 0;font:700 18px "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace}.ds-tear{height:14px;border-top:2px dashed var(--rule);margin:0 16px}

components.name: Split-Flap Status
components.description: Signature: per-letter tiles with a hinge line; flips letter by letter when status changes.
components.css: :host{--ramp-0:#0a0910;--bg:#0f0e14;--surface:#17151f;--surface-2:#211d2c;--rule:#2a2638;--edge:#6e6789;--ink:#f5f3fa;--muted:#aaa4bf;--violet:#7030e0;--violet-press:#5f24c4;--lav:#a19df0;--good:#5ee0a0;--warn:#f5c04e;--bad:#ff7a90} .ds-flap{display:inline-flex;gap:2px;perspective:300px}.ds-flap i{position:relative;width:15px;height:24px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--ramp-0);border:1px solid var(--rule);font:800 16px/22px "Big Shoulders Display", "Archivo Narrow", sans-serif;font-style:normal;text-align:center;color:var(--good);animation:ds-flip 420ms cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1)}.ds-flap i:nth-child(2){animation-delay:45ms}.ds-flap i:nth-child(3){animation-delay:90ms}.ds-flap i:nth-child(4){animation-delay:135ms}.ds-flap i:nth-child(5){animation-delay:180ms}.ds-flap i:nth-child(6){animation-delay:225ms}.ds-flap i::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;right:0;top:50%;height:1px;background:rgba(0,0,0,.65)}@keyframes ds-flip{0%{transform:rotateX(-90deg)}60%{transform:rotateX(12deg)}100%{transform:rotateX(0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-flap i{animation:none}}

components.css: :host{--ramp-0:#0a0910;--bg:#0f0e14;--surface:#17151f;--surface-2:#211d2c;--rule:#2a2638;--edge:#6e6789;--ink:#f5f3fa;--muted:#aaa4bf;--violet:#7030e0;--violet-press:#5f24c4;--lav:#a19df0;--good:#5ee0a0;--warn:#f5c04e;--bad:#ff7a90} .ds-tabs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);width:360px;background:var(--bg);border-top:1px solid var(--rule)}.ds-tabs a{position:relative;padding:20px 0 10px;text-align:center;font:600 12px "Archivo", system-ui, sans-serif;color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer}.ds-tabs a:hover{color:var(--ink)}.ds-tabs a[aria-current]{color:var(--lav)}.ds-tabs a[aria-current]::after{content:"";position:absolute;left:50%;bottom:4px;width:4px;height:4px;margin-left:-2px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lav)}.ds-tabs b{position:absolute;top:3px;left:calc(50% + 4px);min-width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:9px;background:var(--bad);color:var(--ramp-0);font:700 11px/18px "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, monospace}

narrative.overview:
Every hangout is a departure. Home is your boarding pass, Rides is a departure board, and status changes flip like split-flap letters. The system borrows its materials from travel paper and station signage rather than from app dashboards: a printed pass with a violet carrier band, perforated tear lines with punched notches, condensed uppercase signage, monospaced times and seat numbers, and a board of tiles that flip letter by letter. It is dark by design, because it is opened on phones at night, in cars and outside venues.

Density is that of a ticket, not a feed: one pass carries the answer to "when, where, which car, which seat, am I coming", and everything below it is a ruled list. Surfaces sit on one violet-black ramp and are separated by a single 1px rule weight; only the pass, sheets and the toast lift off the page. The logo's two colours do all the brand work: violet fills, lavender marks.

The build refuses the stock dashboard look: rounded soft cards, gradient heroes and icon-box grids do not appear anywhere.
keyCharacteristics: One violet-black tonal ramp for every neutral, from tile black (#0a0910) to ink (#f5f3fa).
Logo violet fills primary actions, the pass band and selected segments; lavender marks codes, the active tab, focus and whatever is yours.
Three type voices with strict jobs: Big Shoulders Display for signage, Archivo for reading, JetBrains Mono for times, codes, seats and money.
One 1px rule weight; dashed 2px lines only where paper tears or a fare totals.
Split-flap tiles are the signature: status words flip in letter by letter when they change.

rules.name: The One Ramp Rule
rules.body: Every neutral comes from the violet-black ramp. No neutral grey from outside it, no pure black, no pure white except text on violet.

rules.name: The Fill and Mark Rule
rules.body: Violet fills; lavender marks. Violet is never used as a text or line colour on the dark ground, and lavender is never a large fill (its fill use is the 12% wash and the small selected-option mark).

rules.name: The Signal Wash Rule
rules.body: Green, amber and rose appear as text, 1px strokes at 40 to 55% opacity, or a 12% wash. A solid signal fill is reserved for the one control or alert that resolves the moment (Accept, a ticked task check, the outside banner, the error toast, badge counts, the money meter).

rules.name: The Three Voices Rule
rules.body: Big Shoulders is signage and is always uppercase; Archivo is everything you read; JetBrains Mono is only for times, codes, seats and money, always with tabular numbers. A sentence never sets in mono, and a number you compare never sets in Archivo.

rules.name: The Signage Has No Lowercase Rule
rules.body: Any Big Shoulders setting is uppercase with positive tracking (0.005em at display sizes, up to 0.14em at 12px labels).

rules.name: The One Rule Weight Rule
rules.body: Every divider is 1px in `rule`. The only other line is a 2px dashed `rule`, and it means paper: the pass tear line and the fare total.

rules.name: The One Lift Rule
rules.body: Only the pass, sheets and the toast cast a shadow. Lists, boards, polls and fact tables are flat and framed by rules.

rules.name: The Three Radii Rule
rules.body: Tiles 3px, controls 8px, the pass 14px. Anything new picks one of those; nothing gets a soft 16 to 24px card radius.

dos: **Do** take every neutral from the ramp: `ramp-0`, `bg`, `surface`, `surface-2`, `rule`, `edge`, `muted`, `ink`.
**Do** fill only primary actions, the pass band and selected segments with Carrier Violet, and mark codes, the active tab, focus and "yours" with Logo Lavender.
**Do** set every time, code, seat count and amount in JetBrains Mono with tabular numbers, and every Big Shoulders setting in uppercase.
**Do** separate rows with the single 1px rule, and keep the 2px dashed line for tear lines and totals.
**Do** show a status word on the board as split-flap tiles that flip only when the status changes, and render them static under reduced motion.
**Do** strike through what is done or declined (line-through with muted colour) rather than hiding it.
**Do** keep every touch target at least 44px and focus visible as a 2px lavender outline offset 2px.
**Do** colour generated avatars with muted hues (`hsl(h 32% 34%)`) so faces never compete with the violet, and ring your own in lavender.
donts: **Don't** use rounded soft cards, gradient heroes or icon-box grids; this world is a ticket and a board, not a dashboard.
**Don't** add a shadow to anything other than the pass, a sheet or the toast.
**Don't** set sentences in mono or numbers you compare in Archivo.
**Don't** use solid green, amber or rose fills outside Accept, ticked task checks, the outside banner, the error toast, badge counts and the money meter.
**Don't** give a container any radius but 8px (controls, framed tables, polls), 14px (the pass and outside banner) or 18px (sheet tops); soft 16 to 24px card corners are out.
**Don't** add a light theme; the product is dark by design for night use.
